competitorWins: Copernicus Browser is the honest, free front door to Europe's satellite archives: full Sentinel-1/2/3/5P search by date, location, source and cloud cover, true-color and false-color rendering tweaked on the fly, spectral indices like NDVI, 3D views, timelapses, split-image comparisons, raw product downloads and measurement/statistics/histogram tools — all free, open-source, funded by the EU. For serious environmental analysis, wildfire monitoring or vegetation research on public data, it is the deeper, more capable and completely free specialist.
description: Copernicus Browser (commissioned by the European Space Agency) is a free, open-source online viewer for Copernicus Sentinel imagery: search, compare and download satellite data, build timelapses, view in 3D and run analyses like NDVI. Use is free of charge; a free account unlocks advanced features. WorldEye is complementary for the general audience: high-res satellite imagery (Pro) on a free, signup-free 3D globe that also shows live flights, ships, 74,229 cameras, weather, quakes and wildfires — intelligence at a glance rather than an analyst's workstation.
